design.name: govern-h100
design.engine: one H100, vLLM 0.32.0, Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, the campaign's flags with --max-model-len 65536

checks.claim: every unit is exact (units that are not: 0)
checks.against: any unit not exact: it does not count

checks.claim: no call is sent that the recorded run did not send, and none twice
checks.against: any: the scout launched a call the program does not make

checks.claim: no speculative call is evicted: past a test too, the scout places no bet
checks.against: any

checks.claim: **the finish rule, 1:** over the 10, `auto`'s session time is at most 1.02 of `wide`'s
checks.against: above 1.02: a hand-set 128 is better than the governed window on this engine

checks.claim: **the finish rule, 2:** over the 10, `auto`'s root stream seconds are at most 1.05 of `stream`'s
checks.against: above 1.05: the wider window is paid for by the root's own stream

checks.claim: over the 10, `wide` is at 0.84 to 0.93 of `stream` in session time (measured on November 10: 0.874)
checks.against: outside: this launch does not repeat November's

checks.claim: over the 10, `auto` is at 0.78 to 0.93 of `stream` in session time
checks.against: outside

checks.claim: the largest loop (`trec132k-17000237.fix1` turn 4, 3,181 calls): `auto` spends at most 1.10 of `wide`'s seconds after the stream
checks.against: above 1.10: the window's way up from 16 costs more than its width gains

checks.claim: a window of `auto` gets wider than 128
checks.against: 128 or less: the engine or the client stopped it below the best hand-set number

checks.claim: at least half of `auto`'s sub-calls are sent at a window above 16
checks.against: fewer: the window hardly opened

checks.claim: the long turn (`trec132k-17000222.fix2` turn 7) as shipped: `stream` spends at least 450 s after its stream (November: about 530 s, worked out from recorded call times)
checks.against: less: the character budget does not hold the long calls back as I worked out

checks.claim: the long turn: a wider window does nothing for it, `wide` at 0.90 to 1.10 of `stream`
checks.against: outside

checks.claim: the long turn: `auto` spends at most 0.80 of `stream`'s seconds
checks.against: above 0.80: the KV pool admitted no more than the character budget does

checks.claim: in `auto` the engine's KV cache stays at or under 97%
checks.against: above: the pool admitted more than the cache holds

checks.claim: in `auto` the engine preempts nothing
checks.against: any preemption

checks.claim: control: with the character budget lifted and nothing following the load, the four long calls take the KV cache to at least 95% (`wide-open`)
checks.against: below 95%: on this engine and this load the four calls fit, as they did in November next to idle sessions

checks.claim: control: and the 10 pay for it, their session time in `wide-open` at least 1.01 of `wide`'s
checks.against: below 1.01: lifting the budget cost the others nothing here, and the pool's caution bought nothing

checks.claim: the loop that tests each result (`trec132k-17000237.fix2` turn 9): `auto-past` spends at most 0.60 of `auto`'s seconds after the stream
checks.against: above 0.60: going on past the test did not launch the loop ahead

checks.claim: over the 10, `auto-past` is at most 1.00 of `auto` in session time
checks.against: above 1.00

checks.claim: all 11 sessions: `auto` at most 0.90 of `stream` in session time
checks.against: above 0.90

checks.claim: all 11 sessions: `auto-past` at most 0.88 of `stream` in session time
checks.against: above 0.88
